description_en: This topic describes the syntax and examples of the ErasePerson feature for erasing human figures from images
description_zh: 本文介绍图像人体擦除ErasePerson的语法及示例
name: ErasePerson

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the Shanghai region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the mask image. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the Shanghai region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.

The mask image is an RGB 3-channel image, not an alpha channel transparent image
parameters.help_zh:
图像对于Mask的URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。

Mask图是RGB3通道图，而非Alpha通道透明图
parameters.name: user_mask

ImageUrl.description_en:
The URL of the output image.
This URL is a temporary URL that is valid for 30 minutes. After the URL expires, you can no longer access it. To store the file for an extended period of time or permanently, access the URL within 30 minutes, download the file, and then save it to your OSS bucket or another storage location
ImageUrl.description_zh:
输出图像的URL地址。
该URL地址为临时地址，有效期为30分钟，过期后将无法访问。若需要长时间或者永久保存文件，请在30分钟内访问URL地址，下载文件转存到自己的OSS或者其他存储空间
